text:
kevin: proposing a tiny, pointer-first rollout metadata shape to handle pinning + gradual rollouts without embedding orchestration. main ideas: 1) store cohort list + pct, 2) store 'lease' for automatic expiry/heartbeat, 3) store alert pointers (ids) instead of thresholds, 4) single fallback_model, 5) soft_unpin behavior controlled by flags.

anya: can you paste a minimal example? curious how compact it is for SDKs.

kevin: example (pseudo inline): `rollout={cohorts:[{name:canary,pct:2},{name:eu,pct:30}], lease:"ttl=3600,heartbeat=true", alerts:["ap-77"], fallback:"redwood/gpt-slim@v1", allow_auto_unpin:false, soft_unpin:true, reconcile_secs:900}`

lee: love the pointer approach. two questions: precedence with customer pins, and where do we keep snapshot data for audits? we can't stash traces in the main metadata.

sophia: precedence should be explicit in the RFC: customer_pin > tenant_override > rollout_metadata > resolver_default. snapshot data should be a separate pointer field `snapshot_ref` that points at an encrypted artifact in the audit store. metadata only stores that pointer string.

kevin: agree. design rule: metadata stays small & stable (strings, lists). runtime pulls alert defs and snapshot artifacts. runtime decides how to act.

anya: ops safety note: alerts list can contain multiple ids; runtime should evaluate them with policy semantics (all, any, severity). propose `alert_mode` with values `any|all|critical`. default `any`.

lee: for auto-unpin we need a grace/backoff window to avoid flapping. propose `grace_secs` + `backoff_multiplier` so soft_unpin reduces pct over steps: pct -> pct*0.5 -> 0.

sophia: +1 but require `allow_auto_unpin=true` explicitly. default false. also require `snapshot_on_unpin=true` opt-in per rollout to capture metrics at time of unpin.

ops-bot: NOTICE: rollout applied by kevin at 3651117777 for model redwood/gptx-lite@v2. cohorts: canary(2%), eu(30%).

kevin: operational log requirement: when an auto action happens, emit a compact audit event with fields: rollout_id, model, trigger_alert_ids, observed_values_ref, chosen_fallback. keep that in the audit store. not copying the values into primary metadata.

anya: SDK compatibility: keep `lease` as a short string (ttl=3600;hb=true) rather than a nested object to avoid breaking older SDKs and make private deploy parsing simpler. server-side will canonicalize it.

lee: test plan: add unit tests for resolver precedence, TTL expiry behavior (lease heartbeat missing), and soft_unpin backoff loop. integration test should validate alert pointer semantics against telemetry mocks.

sophia: i'll draft the ops runbook for soft_unpin vs hard_unpin, include manual rollback CLI and emergency kill switch. will add sample `curl` snippets.

kevin: i'll update the RFC with compact examples, precedence table, and audit pointer conventions. tagging you all once PR is up. :raised_hands:
